presentation:
Hi! I'm a {age, number} software developer and tinkerer from Italy. Here you can find a portfolio of cool projects I've worked on over the years, both for work and for my own fun. I have been coding since I was 14, starting with C in high school.
I then started to look around beyond that and begun many small personal projects, messing with everything from Pascal to Go, from Python to Javascript, from C# to Nim, from Unity to Godot (and due to them I also got some experience with Blender as well). In the meantime, I first did a Bachelor's in Computer Science and then a Master's in Artificial Intelligence.
Now, when I'm not doing work with Vue and Laravel, I'm either messing around with either Godot, an amazing open source game engine which I've used quite extensively, or managing the several services I'm self hosting on my own home server.
